mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1200 and retail sales below 490000 indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST < 1200 AND RSAFS < 490000) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, industrial production declining below 107.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 107.0 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 147 million indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 147 million (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 1.5% and CPI index above 250 signals monetary tightening with accelerating inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS > 1.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 250) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, federal funds rate exceeding 1.5% signals reduced liquidity, increasing cost of capital and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5 during monetary tightening (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
